Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Use n rows with n-1-r leading spaces. First and last rows contain n stars; other rows keep only the first and last star of the n-column body.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "  ***",
    " * *",
    "***"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Construct the body separately from its indentation.

Complexity: O(n^2) output characters

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: hollow-rhombus.py
solutions.code:
def solve(n):
    return [' '*(n-1-r)+('*'*n if r in (0,n-1) or n<2 else '*'+' '*(n-2)+'*') for r in range(n)]
